changed: Investigated Order Flow Absorption. Conducted full EDA (Quadrant Analysis, Minitab Main Effects / Interaction Plots, Continuous KDE PairGrid) which structurally confirmed that wicks map to passive limit absorption of aggressive flow (True Delta). The direction hypothesis is officially DEAD, pending a pivot to the Exhaustion (reversal) target for the true test.
look_for: The next step is the Stage 1 Exhaustion 3-Layer Ablation (`stage_1_inflection_ablation.py`). Watch for the marginal lift of Layer 3 (True Delta) over Layer 2 (Free Wick Absorption) on the exhaustion target to finalize the tick-data purchase decision.
impact: The directional predictive model is aborted, averting a false-positive implementation. Pending the exhaustion test, we may save significant compute and latency if the free OHLCV wicks outperform or match the True Delta data.
